summary: Comprehensive harness audit report analyzing why Gemini models drift from the Antigravity 6-Step Chain. Identifies 7 architectural gaps (no chain step tracker, prompt size vs attention budget, competing instruction sources, no finalize enforcement, internalization assumption, no protocol activation verification, workflow override ambiguity). Performs model-harness separation, scaffolding gap analysis, and complexity audit. Provides risk assessment for potential fixes and recommends Option A (accept the drift, continue Claude as primary) to protect existing system functionality.
